hook.line: We've all heard about SEO, right? Did you know there's now something called AEO?
hook.visual: Static medium shot holding a fluffy wireless mic to her chin in front of a styled bookshelf; word-by-word caption pops in at 0.75 s, key word set large

beats.what: Silent first beat, then 'we've all heard about SEO, right?'
'Did you know' reveal: AEO, answer engine optimization
Why: people now ask ChatGPT or Claude what they used to Google
SEO still matters, but making your site AEO-accessible matters more
Defines it: chatbots can read your site so you get recommended
Tip: sites exist where you type your URL and get a list of fixes
'Google it, if Google's still a thing' joke and send-off
Closes on 'hope this helps' with a smile

why_it_works: Starts from a term everyone knows (SEO) and adds one new word (AEO), so a beginner feels caught up in under a minute
Captions enlarge one key word per chunk ('ABLE TO', 'NEEDS TO BE'), giving rhythm to a static shot
Self-aware 'if Google's still a thing' joke lands the thesis with a smile at the end
weaknesses: The tool tip is vague: no site named or shown, so there is nothing to save
One unchanging 52 s shot with no cuts, zooms or graphics
Captions sit over the handheld mic, which hides letters (e.g. 'S E O' split around it)
for_robert: Avoid vague 'there are tools for this' tips; name and show one tool, and keep caption text clear of props or Fred's sprite.
